basis: Lilly preferment judgment: querent signified by the Ascendant and Venus; the office by the tenth house. The Moon is placed in the tenth (in the very house of the thing sought) and applies to a trine of Saturn; Saturn has exaltation in the Ascendant and receives Venus and is received by her again — a mutual reception between the querent's significator Venus and Saturn, the planet the Moon applies to — which in Lilly's rules perfects the matter by reception despite other impediments; Saturn being also lord of the fourth (the end of the matter) ties a good end to the same perfecting planet. The impediment is identified and quarantined: the Sun in the seventh in opposition to the Ascendant and with the Dragon's Tail, being lord of the eleventh (the pretended solar friend), shows the friend will oppose/hinder rather than help — but an afflicted significator of a third party does not break a perfection already made by Moon, reception and the tenth-house placement. The Moon separating from a square of Mercury is a past trouble, separating, not applying. Verdict: he obtains the preferment, and not by his friend's help.
prediction_text: He will obtain the office/preferment he looks after. The Moon in the tenth applying by trine to Saturn, with mutual reception between Venus (the querent) and Saturn (who is exalted in the Ascendant and lord of the fourth, the end of the matter), perfects the attainment. It will not come by his pretended friend: the Sun, lord of the eleventh, in the seventh in opposition to the Ascendant with the Dragon's Tail, marks that solar friend as false and opposing — the place is gained despite him, not through him.
timing: Month scale: window of the coming weeks to months as the Moon completes her trine to Saturn; main coordinate at that perfection — no degree count is stated in the prose, so no single day is asserted
